spec.kitLine: all enemies / on entering Full Burst
spec.assertion: Asserts a boss-held buffApply (casterIdx===null AND targetIdx===null) with value -19.93 exactly once per fullBurstStart, plus strict damage-inertness when the slot is emptied. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'ATK-down read as a team ATK buff' (which inflates crow AND teammates) and under a burstCast re-keying (which changes the application count/frames).

The engine has no boss-ATK consumer, so the line moves zero damage. Asserted by an equality check on the full totals map with skill1 emptied — this pins that no one has smuggled the debuff into an ally-facing or damageTakenPct channel.

Asserts the skill-bucket rider count tracks the reload count (+-1 for the partial final magazine), lands with rangeApplied falsy and coreRate 0, and is load-bearing (removal strictly lowers crow's total). Fails under the nearest-wrong shotFired keying, which fires ~60x more often per magazine and raises the total.

Asserts a self-targeted defPct buffApply (casterIdx===targetIdx) at value 12.72, with expiresFrame-frame === 300 (5s at 60fps) and durationShots undefined — discriminating seconds from a ROUND-count reading. Asserts its count equals the 89.09% rider count (same activation clause), and that removing it changes no damage anywhere.

Asserts burst-bucket instances with fbMajorApplied falsy on every one (burst-cast damage lands before Full Burst opens — a verified project fact), a plausible cast-count range for cd 40s over 180s, and non-vacuity via removal. Fails under the nearest-wrong fullBurstEnter keying, which sets fbMajorApplied and inflates the total by the +50% FB major.
Untestable at scope: the fight has exactly one enemy, so the selection clause collapses to target:enemy. Recorded as it.skip rather than asserted.

fixtures: controlComp('crow', true) only — one comp, six hoisted runs of it (base + five withPatchedOverride counterfactuals: S1-as-ally-buff, S1-as-burstCast, S2a-as-shotFired, S2a-removed, burst-as-fullBurstEnter, burst-removed) plus two inline removal runs (skill1 emptied, defPct stripped). The fixed-B3 flag is TRUE because crow is Burst III and a lone B3 makes ZERO full bursts — without B1+B2 the skill1 fullBurstEnter line would never fire and her burst would never cast, making every assertion vacuous. The fixed B3 slot is a buffer, but none of crow's assertions read an absolute damage magnitude (all are counts, event fields, or relative before/after comparisons of the SAME comp), so its buffs cannot confound the readings. Boss is Fire and crow is Fire — no elemental advantage in play, which is a wash for structural asserts.
gaps: S1 ATK-down 19.93% magnitude: the sim models no boss offense, so the value has no observable damage consequence — encoded for completeness, verified only via its buffApply event and a strict damage-inertness equality.

SMG cadence tuple (pulls/sec): ALWAYS-⚑ #1 (rate_of_fire is a known-unreliable datamine field, and the effective rate is frame-quantized to 60/ceil(60/nominal)). No exact shot or magazine count is asserted anywhere — every count assertion is a range or a relative comparison.
'The enemy with the highest final ATK': single-boss scope collapses the selection clause to target:enemy; discriminating the selection rule would need a multi-enemy fixture that does not exist.

hitsPerShot 2 with ammo 120 implies ~60 trigger pulls per magazine, but whether the engine's ammo economy spends 2 rounds per pull for an SMG is not stated in the kit text — the lastBullet cadence is therefore asserted against the observed reload count rather than a derived pull count.
